source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Fuel, p.6M-17

procedures.title: Engine fuel special tools (figure 1T)
steps: Use the figure to identify the J-numbered tools for carburetor and fuel system work.
notes: Tools shown: J-22973 (gauge), J-10176, J-9789 (cased set), J-8328 (set of 4), and bending tools J-1137, J-4552, J-5197, J-6058A, J-5496, J-6556.
